statement: For every finite horizon, sequences satisfying the Bellman super-solution inequalities upper-bound V_b^*, sequences satisfying the sub-solution inequalities lower-bound V_b^*, and their endpoint difference is a provability-certificate gap.

quantifiers.functions: every [0,1]-valued sequence satisfying the respective base and Bellman inequalities
quantifiers.states: every state x at every b <= B
quantifiers.mdp: every reachability MDP for which the bounded Bellman operator is defined

proof_obligations: The reachability Bellman operator is pointwise monotone.
The super-solution base and recurrence imply U_b >= V_b^* by induction.
The sub-solution base and recurrence imply L_b <= V_b^* by induction.
The endpoint inequalities imply the Definition 5 certificate and nonnegative gap.
verification_condition: An exact proof kernel validates both induction certificates and the Bellman monotonicity dependency chain; an independent SMT checker proves the negations of both generic induction steps unsatisfiable; a recurrence-violation control exits nonzero.
